map.本工具用于检测（扭矩/硬度/尺寸）服务的合法性校验，依据对应数据格式与语法规范实: This tool validates the (torque / hardness / dimension) testing service against the corresponding data format and syntax rules in real time, locating errors; it runs entirely in the browser and uploads no data.
map.📚 深度解析：紧固件三项检测判定（扭矩/硬度/尺寸）: 📚 Deep Dive: Three-Item Test for Fasteners (Torque / Hardness / Dimension)
map.紧固件自检：按拧紧扭矩、硬度、尺寸偏差三项判定: Fastener self-check: judge by three items — tightening torque, hardness, dimensional deviation
map.装配可靠：扭矩与硬度关系预紧力与防松: Assembly reliability: torque and hardness relate to preload and locking
map.报告可用性：三项全合格方可用于装配验收: Report usability: all three must pass before assembly acceptance
map.逐项判定：拧紧扭矩 80~120N·m、硬度 28~34HRC、尺寸偏差≤0.0: Item-by-item: tightening torque 80~120 N·m, hardness 28~34 HRC, dimensional deviation ≤ 0.05 mm; all three satisfied = pass. Torque sets preload; hardness prevents breaking on tightening; dimension ensures fit.
map.扭矩 100N·m（区间✓）、硬度 30HRC（区间✓）、尺寸偏差 0.03mm: Torque 100 N·m (range ✓), hardness 30 HRC (range ✓), dimensional deviation 0.03 mm (≤0.05 ✓): all three pass → qualified. If torque rises to 130 N·m it fails, beyond spec and easy to snap.
map.扭矩区间为什么重要？: Why is the torque range important?
map.过小预紧不足易松脱、过大易拧断或螺纹滑牙；80~120N·m 为示例窗口，实际须: Too small gives insufficient preload and easy loosening; too large easily snaps or strips threads. 80~120 N·m is an example window — actual torque depends on grade and friction coefficient.
map.该区间对应中碳紧固件常用调质硬度，过低易塑性变形、过高脆；须与强度等级匹配，并复: This range corresponds to common quench-tempered hardness of medium-carbon fasteners; too low easily plastic-deforms, too high brittle; must match strength grade and recheck the torque–preload relation.
map.扭矩测试需使用标定过的扭矩扳手: Torque testing requires a calibrated torque wrench
map.硬度测试需在规定位置测量: Hardness testing requires measurement at specified locations
map.关于「检测（扭矩/硬度/尺寸）服务」: About the Torque / Hardness / Dimension Testing Service
map.紧固件拧紧扭矩、硬度、尺寸偏差三项检测工具，依据GB/T 16823、GB/T: A three-item testing tool for fastener tightening torque, hardness, and dimensional deviation, judging pass/fail per standards such as GB/T 16823, GB/T 230, GB/T 1800. Suitable for quality testing of bolts, nuts, and other fasteners.
map.支持拧紧扭矩、硬度、尺寸偏差等多项指标检测: Supports testing of multiple indicators including tightening torque, hardness, and dimensional deviation
